provenance: Human-verified labels for the first labelled audio in this project. This file is the authoritative machine-readable copy; ground-truth-2026-08-18.md is its prose companion and carries the corrections it forced. A copy of these numbers also exists as a Python constant in sensein/agentharness scripts/score_against_labels.py, which predates this file and should be read as derived from it, not as a second source.
scoring: onset_lo/onset_hi bound where an onset may fall; a claim inside that window scores as a hit. span_lo/span_hi bound the event's extent. status 'unresolved' means the region is neither a hit nor a miss and must not be scored either way.
